quote: Malabar Wastewater Treatment Plant and Pipeline Network, Trinidad and Tobago (40,000 m 3 /d). Located in the catchment area of Malabar, the project covers an area of 27 square kilometers and can treat the domestic sewage of more than 110,000 households… The main content of the project includes the wastewater treatment plant with a designed capacity of 40,000 m 3 /d and a year of O&M.
